history.summary: Small freehold boutique 2BR in D15 Eunos at $1.23M / $1,542 PSF, attractively priced in absolute terms but a poor appreciation profile (1.9%/yr on only 8 URA transactions) and weak liquidity. The low entry price is the only real draw; everything else is mediocre.
history.rating_rationale: Resale-only URA CAGR is just 1.89%/yr — well below the RCR ~5.8% baseline — though on a thin 8-transaction series so confidence is low. PSF of $1,542 is ~4% above the $1,486 URA median. Boutique freehold blocks like this are illiquid (126-291-7 arena record, Elo 896), and 950m to Eunos MRT is a real walk. Saved from Avoid only by the sub-$1.25M entry and FH tenure in a deep D15 buyer market.
red_flags: Weak 1.9%/yr appreciation on only 8 transactions (unreliable but directionally soft)
Boutique development — thin liquidity, limited amenities
catalysts: Low absolute entry price under $1.25M widens the buyer pool
Freehold tenure in established D15 East Coast
